status: specification; the development screen below is pre-registered in this file before it ran; no external study is registered
production_default: unchanged; no protocol-v2 arm is imported by src/

estimand.primary: paired difference in correct terminal decisions, candidate minus fixed expert order, on identical episodes
estimand.unit: independent compound component (identity or Murcko scaffold connected component); episodes, cell lines, doses and replicates are never units

acquisition.population: every metadata-eligible compound (identity, structure, study metadata, planned conditions); no label needed

mechanism.population: compounds with a reliable post-hoc label whose class is in the reference-defined pool
mechanism.generalisation_limit: results hold for label-compatible compounds only; never extrapolate to all unseen compounds

task_gate.eligible_primary: oracle-minus-fixed correct headroom >= 2 x mpie_correct and its lower 95% bound >= mpie_correct
task_gate.powered: units required for 80% power at two-sided 5% to detect mpie_correct <= units available; SE from the current planner's paired difference

population_minimums.confirmatory_units: the larger of 500 and the development power model's units_required_for_mpie for the chosen task
population_minimums.below_minimum: only INCONCLUSIVE or descriptive statements are allowed

success_all_required: measurement difference upper 95% bound <= +0.10 per episode and assay-day difference upper bound <= +0.6

direction of the correct difference positive in every sensitivity stratum with >= 50 units (Murcko scaffold seen or held out, study, batch, cell-line overlap, structural applicability), and lower bound > 0 when re-clustered by Murcko scaffold and by batch
registration verified at its commit, the vault opened once, and a decision-level replay identical
failure_any: correct difference upper 95% bound < 0.02 (practically meaningful gain excluded)
gain only in one stratum, study or batch
fewer measurements without more correct decisions (a cost trade, not an improvement)
integrity_invalidates_conclusion: an episode scored without a truth, or with a truth outside its contrast
a manifest or registration digest mismatch at the registration commit
a rewritten freeze, registration or replay
a policy that receives a held-out label, profile, QC field or validator outcome
an unregistered external file read after registration
a not-measured condition executed or scored as a biological or QC outcome

data_boundary.policy_view: research/protocol_v2/contracts.py PublicContext: training reference tables, their validator calibration, menu and pool, structures and unit keys, planned-condition availability, per-fold caches
fixed_before_external_labels: candidate contrasts (every pair of pool classes, truth-free)
data_boundary.scoring: contracts.score joins the truth after execution; missing or out-of-contrast truth raises TruthMissing
data_boundary.not_measured_rule: never offered; choosing one raises NotMeasured; never charged, never scored

anchored.role: current planner anchored to fixed by a 1.645-SE rule

safe_class.role: sensitivity: safe without the structural-applicability gate

belief_robust.role: robustness: current planner with a contamination-mixture belief update

oracle.role: upper bound; reads hidden outcomes; never a competitor

support_rule.sources: existing registered constants: lincs_prepare.POOL_MIN_IDENTITIES, POOL_MIN_DETECTED_IDENTITIES, world.SIM_FLOOR, arms.DEVIATION_Z, belief-planning-1 wrong_noninferiority_margin

calibration.stop_gate_rule: overall observed wrong rate <= mean bound, >= 95% of strata (n >= 20) covered, no stratum significantly above the bound, on both leave-one-study-out development targets
calibration.stop_gate_note: passes only because the planner's Jeffreys bound is 10-35 times the observed rate (L1000 35x, SciPlex3 15x, GSE70138 9.5x); the hierarchical and discounted bounds fail on SciPlex3 and post hoc on GSE70138
calibration.eps_rule: the grid value minimising pooled development log loss of the posterior on the truth after a non-eliminating first reading (grid 0, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
calibration.derived_from: registered belief-planning-1 development records and, post hoc only, its GSE70138 records; computed at 11:55-12:00 +0800 before the development screen ran

development_screen.name: protocol-v2-dev-screen
development_screen.data: the 20 registered development tasks (SciPlex3 A/B, L1000 LT/T, 5 folds each), forced-choice episodes identical to belief-planning-1
development_screen.disclosure: every development tier has been analysed repeatedly since 2026-09-26, and the safe arm was designed after seeing belief-planning-1's development and external results; the screen can only rule candidates out
development_screen.safety_screen: safe is SAFE_ON_DEVELOPMENT if, in every tier, the correct difference lower bound >= -0.01 and the wrong difference upper bound <= +0.005 against fixed
development_screen.signal_screen: safe ADVANCES to an external registration only if, in a tier that passes the task gate, the correct difference estimate >= 0.02 with lower bound > 0; otherwise NO_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL
development_screen.replay_check: arms shared with belief-planning-1 must reproduce its registered decisions exactly on compounds whose planned conditions are all available
